summary: V2339 reconciles24 historical COMMON Planning19/Finance20 comments1447-1470 as fresh, individually justified retentions. Every clean Japanese comment was reread with its actual role, NPC voice, protagonist and consumer context. They are independent alternatives, not a sequential exchange. The scheming comments preserve tentative planning, study, acquired experience, confidence and the protagonists' distinct attitudes. The source 練る/寝る devising/sleeping joke becomes dream up a plan followed by snoring and Wrong kind of dreaming, preserving its comic sequence through an English double meaning. The finance comments preserve multiport market prices, current demand, prospective profit, this month's accounting, uncertainty and Lil's overwhelmed reaction.
